notes.title: NEW UPDATE FOR VILLAIN'S LEGACY
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
A new update is here! 
This one's quite huge, compared to the last one.
With this update:
-new missions for The Mind's allies are available: send your minions and followers on different quests to earn money and other resources!
-several pictures from the image gallery have been re-rendered and others have been added too!
-a few scenes have been polished (in writing or graphics, or both); ie. Wonder Girl's story has been mostly reworked and will have a new ending in the next update.
-Incredible's quest reaches a turning point, while several characters' stories reach their conclusion.

With the next update, I hope to close all the current plots.
While it may not be the last update, I hope to include the story finale too!
I hope you'll be looking forward to it!

Please continue to follow Villain's Legacy's development and to support me.
Stay tuned for more news by following our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2211090]Steam page[/url].

Changelog:
-added about 15k words
-added about 850 images
-fixed over 200 renders from some of WonderGirl's scenes
-reworked 10 images from the gallery
-added 8 new images to the gallery
-not all changes may work in existing save files!

notes.title: NEW UPDATE FOR VILLAIN'S LEGACY
notes.content:
Hello everyone, sorry for the long wait.
Had a few personal issues that took a lot of time out of the game's development, but the project's not abandoned at all!
Please continue to follow Villain's Legacy's development and to support me.
Stay tuned for more news by following our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2211090]Steam page[/url].

Changelog:
-added about 15000 words
-added about 750 images
-fixed several video player issues
-reworked the intro scene, adding a few images and rewriting a lot of it, making it more enjoyable to read through.
-added two new icons to the Computer function (Hints and Cheats.)
	There is currently no Cheats implemented, but will add a few in the next updates.
	The Hints function will be used as a FAQ and guide page.
-added a lot of words to the Web Search function.
-added missing requirements to older scenes.
-started adjusting the cost of the Material Components. 
	They're still cheap, so the game won't get any grindier.
	I plan on implementing even more ways to get Money and other ways to use Fame in the future.

Since a few labels and scripts have been reworked the game may run into some issues.
Hopefully not all the save files will break, but some may unfortunately not work anymore.
Since the game is still in development and I want to fix a lot of it, I hope you'll be forgiving.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208644/310d6858be0f0bfc79da52bf9a23acd9ac84ea6c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch fix for Villain's Legacy!
notes.content:
Hello everyone. 

We wanted to tell you that we made a patch fix of the game by solving the following problems:

- Fixed an issue that was breaking the Replay Gallery. 
- Fixed an issue that did not allow the connection between Renpy and Steam causing malfunctions in the game.
- Fixed minor bugs.

*Problems with Steam Deck still being tested.*

We also added 4 new achievements related to the new scenes released with the September update.

Please stay tuned for more news by following our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2211090]Steam page[/url].

notes.title: Update for Villain's Legacy!
notes.content:
[h2]Update with new content[/h2]

Hello everyone! We wanted to announce that we have released the new Villain's Legacy update! The new update contains 30,000 new words, 500 new pictures, 10 new animations and 4 new achievements.

We also fixed a bug that did not allow some scenes in the new update to be played using old saves.

Thanks to the new update you will also be able to play on Steam decks!

Please stay tuned for more news by following our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2211090]Steam page[/url].

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 1.1
notes.content:
[h2]Achievements bug fixed[/h2]

We are distributing an update to improve the stability of gameplay and to adjust balance.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but please apply the latest update before you enjoy the game.

The bug that did not allow any achievement to be unlocked has been fixed. If you have a save with a scene already played just start any activity on the map and then return to the base of The Mind to unlock all the anomalously blocked achievements.


We will continue to provide improvement update in the future so you can enjoy Villain's Legacy  more comfortably.

Please stay tuned for more news by following our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2211090]Steam page[/url].
